content: {"rules": ["The model exhibits a persistent upward bias, consistently overestimating prices by 2-5 EUR across all horizons.", "Forecasts fail to capture the magnitude of the sharp downward trend (mean reversion) observed in the true data, showing a significant lag in reacting to price drops.", "The model incorrectly predicts a recovery or stabilization after the initial drop, whereas the true outcome continues a steep decline.", "Sentiment spikes (values of 0.67 or 1.00) in the history do not trigger corresponding upward adjustments in the forecast, indicating the model underweights positive sentiment signals during downtrends.", "Correction Rule: Apply a downward adjustment of 3-4 EUR to the base forecast and introduce a negative momentum factor to account for the accelerating decline not captured by the model."]}
